claim: The bounded cohort contains 25 large sponsor-led software take-private transactions announced from 2020 through 2022.
Company-reported headline transaction values sum to $171.2 billion.
evidence_basis: Row-level headline value field; mixed company definitions

claim: No deal qualifies as a clean sponsor realization under the control-based definition at the evidence cutoff.
An IPO is treated as a liquidity route, not a realization, when the sponsor retains voting control.
Creditor ownership is classified separately from sponsor realization.
The public record cannot establish cohort MOIC, IRR, or impairment.
evidence_basis: Missing sponsor cash-flow and fund-mark data

claim: Transaction value is not sponsor equity invested.
Partial sales, dividends, refinancings, and continuation transactions do not by themselves prove gain or loss.
Most deals were three to five years into ownership at the cutoff.
evidence_basis: Announcement and close dates versus evidence cutoff

claim: The result should be read as an exit-inventory audit, not a verdict on the vintage.
